title: A localized motive question presented with internal option codes and an untranslated metric label

question.text: 本期實況：最大單一部位 COST 佔 55%。 這次「部位 sizing」背後，主要是事先規劃、情緒反應，還是外部限制？

answers.note: #262's first two complaints, reproduced on the one engine question that carries a dimension label in its stem: the option labels were the engine's canonical codes rather than its copy, and the dimension arrived in English inside a Traditional Chinese session. The third complaint in #262 — the HTML card never reaching the screen — is a presentation-trace question (ux_receipt.py card_presented), not an answer-surface question, and no episode can grade it.
answers.prose: 本期實況：最大單一部位 COST 佔 55%。這次 position sizing 背後，主要是什麼原因？

presented_options.label: deliberate_plan
presented_options.description: 行動遵循交易前就存在的規則。

presented_options.label: emotional_reaction
presented_options.description: 恐懼、後悔或急迫感主導了行動。

presented_options.label: external_constraint
presented_options.description: 資金、稅務或其他限制主導了行動。

presented_options.label: 先跳過
presented_options.description: 這次先不替動機下定論。

answers.note: Deliberately NOT the engine's own copy. This answer is freely worded — no v1 template produced it — and it still passes every check, which is the point: the invariants are about not leaking engine identifiers and not mixing an untranslated metric label into a localized surface, never about matching today's phrasing. Owner direction, 2026-07-26: answers should get freer, more varied and more restrained; a pass here is a witness that the invariants hold, not a model answer to copy.
answers.prose: COST 目前佔了這個帳戶的 55%。當初把它加到這個份量，是照著進場前就定好的規則，還是當下的情緒推的，或者有資金、稅務上的限制？

presented_options.label: 照原本的計畫
presented_options.description: 這個份量在進場前就決定好了，不是後來才變成這樣。

presented_options.label: 當下情緒推的
presented_options.description: 加上去的那一刻，主要是怕錯過，或是不想承認看錯。

presented_options.label: 有外部限制
presented_options.description: 資金、稅務或其他限制讓它只能是這個份量。

presented_options.label: 先跳過
presented_options.description: 這次先不替這個份量下定論。
